THE RECONSTRUCTION

Research & accuracy

This is an explorable fan reconstruction, built at human scale. The show establishes 144 numbered levels, the great staircase and the principal departments. No complete, dimensioned, room-by-room production blueprint was available in the references reviewed.

The 10 m level spacing, 36 m central shaft diameter and room plans are reconstruction estimates. Unseen floors use furnished layouts fitted to the silo. Department locations without reliable television confirmation are marked in the directory.

The connected Level 1 cafeteria, sheriff’s station, preparation area, pressure doors and ramp lead to an explorable barren surface. Clean the exterior camera with Use / E; its live view feeds the wall screens. The generator hall now lies below Level 144. The cavern and digging machine follow published production references. The mines and hidden passage contain inferred details. Spoilers for the television world are present.

The circular collision system and selected interior models come from your Lost Signal repository. This is an empty environment: no characters, bodies or combat.
